environment.description: EKS 1.28 cluster with Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-exec-params' in enforce mode that validates all container args and command fields against regex pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9_/.-]+$ (no shell metacharacters). Pod deployed with securityContext.seccompProfile set to RuntimeDefault via PodSecurity admission (baseline). The pod's ServiceAccount has an IAM Role annotation (IRSA) scoped to eks:DescribeCluster only, with a Condition key 'aws:RequestedRegion' restricting to us-east-1. Additionally, a Cilium L7 NetworkPolicy on namespace 'operations-prod' enforces gRPC method-level filtering allowing only '/admin.AdminService/ExecuteMaintenanceTask' with a header match requiring 'x-auth-token' presence validated against OIDC issuer. The node group uses Bottlerocket AMI with kernel lockdown=integrity, and the pod spec includes readOnlyRootFilesystem: true with no writable volume mounts except emptyDir at /tmp (noexec mount option via Kyverno mutating policy).

config.kyverno_policy: restrict-exec-params in enforce mode, regex validation on all container command/args
config.cilium_l7_policy: gRPC method filter + mandatory x-auth-token header validated via OIDC
